title: Context <-> answer influence evidence (Sources evidence lens, feature 07)
description: The versioned artifact clozn.receipts.context_answer_influence.context_answer_influence() returns and clozn/server/routes/influence_map.py persists at run['influence_map']. Measures the spec's forced_score_intervention mode ONLY -- never attention_proxy, never a percentage, never a claim about document correctness or hidden reasoning (see method.caveat, present on every shape below). schema/status/available/method/identity are the only keys guaranteed on every call, success or failure -- everything else is present only when it was actually produced, per the project's omit-never-null-pad rule. This retrofits Seam 2 onto an artifact that shipped before clozn/schemas/ existed; the field name is 'schema', not 'schema_version' -- callers must pass the schema name explicitly to clozn.schemas.validate() rather than relying on inference.

status.description: 'ok' means the full matrix/links below are real measurements. 'unavailable' means a precondition (no scorer, no text context, no recorded continuation) was never met -- not a failure of the method. 'error' means an intervention that should have worked did not complete. Both non-ok statuses always carry 'error'.

available.description: True only when status == 'ok'. Never true with a partially-populated matrix.

identity.description: Which run, model, substrate, and exact rendered-prompt view this evidence is anchored to (clozn.receipts.context_answer_influence._identity()). Not itself a measurement claim.

prompt_sources.description: Every candidate prompt source considered, selected or not (selection.selected_source_ids / omitted_source_ids says which). Presence in this list licenses ONLY 'this text was in the assembled prompt' -- never 'measured' or 'influenced'.

offsets.description: Always unicode_code_points / half_open per this module -- see PromptSpan/AnswerSpan start/end.

thresholds.description: The method-specific floor a link's abs_delta_nats must clear to be evidence_state=causally_supported. Never a universal 'influence score' (spec's own rule).

matrix.description: The complete measured [prompt_span x answer_span] signed-delta matrix. 'links' below is the same data flattened with per-cell evidence_state; matrix is retained so the interactive lens's sparse top-link view is never mistaken for the whole measured surface (docs/PRODUCT_ROADMAP.md item 7).

artifact_sha256.description: Digest of the artifact with wall-clock timing stripped -- stable across re-runs of the identical evidence, per context_answer_influence.py's own test coverage.

mode.description: notes/agent_roadmap/07-sources-evidence-lens.md's exact mode enum. This module always emits forced_score_intervention -- it never reads or reports raw attention weight as evidence.

claim_limit.description: What every delta_nats/effect in this artifact does NOT license: a percentage, an attention explanation, an internal mediation result, or a circuit explanation.

caveat.description: The spec's required persistent caveat, verbatim: influence means this context changed the measured output under this intervention; it does not prove the document is correct or reveal hidden reasoning. Present on every shape this module returns, success or failure.

code.description: The closed set clozn.receipts.context_answer_influence.ERROR_CODES defines. A code outside this enum means the module and this schema have drifted -- fix the schema, do not widen it silently.

start.description: Unicode code-point offset, half-open [start, end) into this source's exact text.

delta_nats.description: Signed teacher-forced logprob delta for ONE recorded answer token under this ONE span's matched-length-filler replacement. Licenses a claim about this exact intervention on this exact recorded continuation only -- never about a freely-regenerated answer, and never that this is the token's only cause (see redundancy_check).

effect.description: Sign of delta_nats only -- not a magnitude claim comparable across spans of different lengths without also reading the matched-length control.

clears_floor.description: Whether abs_delta_nats met thresholds.cell_abs_delta_nats. False is NOT evidence the source was irrelevant -- see evidence_state.

evidence_state.description: The roadmap's explicit-states vocabulary applied to this one number. causally_supported: this link cleared the measurement floor -- a real, controlled intervention effect. observed: the intervention ran and produced this delta, but it did not clear the floor -- measured absence of a strong effect, never proof of irrelevance.
